author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Farewell, Thanos! While we enjoy Marvel, we’ve got bigger fish to fry…or rather Dragons to Hunt! It’s going to my friend​⁠ @JoelareMagic ​⁠ , who is a HUGE Marvel fan (and a great follow for MTG players). I’m going to use the $ from selling this guy to give us a few more chances at Gold Smaug from #mtgxhobbit (and upgrade my kids’ commander decks with some singles).

#mtgxmarvel #magicthegathering
title: Goodbye, Thanos Soul Stone! #mtgxmarvel
